استجيرا (form X)
# اُسْتُجِيرَا (ustujīrā) /us.tu.d͡ʒiː.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَجَارَ (istajāra)
# اِسْتَجِيرَا (istajīrā) /is.ta.d͡ʒiː.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَجَارَ (istajāra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
